summary: For each synchronized detection and depth pair, send stage 2 the two class-matched pallet faces with the largest area_px, breaking remaining ties by higher score and then by lower source index, and mark every other candidate deferred. Each admitted face is passed to estimate_pose_chamfer_v3_2, and each success publishes its own PalletPoseStamped from that capture. Each deferred candidate is published as its source index together with this pair's RGB and depth stamps. A pair with fewer than two candidates admits every candidate and defers none. The handling process then has the poses of the large faces in this capture and the identities of the detections this pair did not pose, while the scene can still change.
hypothesis: on_pair keeps only the one candidate select_detection returns and drops the rest with no deferred mark, even though every candidate already has area_px and source_index. A high score on a small box is then the only pose, and a larger pallet in the same array is neither posed nor marked deferred, so handling cannot tell which faces were left before the scene moves. Admitting the two largest faces and stamping the other source indices on this pair is that split.
